title: Qivalis wins Dutch e-money license for euro stablecoin
message_html: Qivalis wins Dutch e-money license for euro stablecoin ...
snippet: Qivalis said the Electronic Money Institution authorization enables it to launch a euro-denominated stablecoin, with issuance planned for the coming months, subject to additional MiCA requirements.

message_html: Polygon Labs completes Coinme acquisition, bringing regulated payments coverage across 48 US states ...
